title: BRAG: Bayesian Retrieval Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.31656v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) ranks memory chunks by semantic similarity to the query. Many methods improve on this by learning from feedback on what was retrieved, but each is a separate heuristic, with no account of when it is the right choice. We introduce BRAG, a generative model of retrieval with use. Each chunk generates the queries it answers from a mixture of von Mises-Fisher components anchored at its original embedding, and each chunk has a latent utility that drifts over time. The model gives the optimal inference, a closed-form filter that stores a few keys and two scalars per chunk and updates them online from the labels of a curator, and it frames retrieval as a control problem. It also shows when existing methods are optimal. Query averaging, Rocchio-style feedback and frequency reranking are special cases with fixed parameters, NUDGE is the case of one key per chunk with no dynamics, and LADER the limit of one key

translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）根据与查询的语义相似度对记忆块进行排序。许多方法通过从检索内容的反馈中学习来改进这一方式，但每种方法都是独立的启发式方法，没有说明它在何时才是正确的选择。我们提出了BRAG，一个结合使用情况的检索生成模型。每个块从锚定在其原始嵌入上的von Mises-Fisher分量混合中生成它所回答的查询，并且每个块拥有一个随时间漂移的潜在效用。该模型给出了最优推理——一种闭式滤波器，它为每个块只存储少量键和两个标量，并根据管理者的标签在线更新它们，同时将检索框架化为一个控制问题。该模型还阐明了现有方法在何时是最优的：查询平均、Rocchio风格的反馈和频率重排序是参数固定的特殊情况，NUDGE是每块单个键且无动态的情形，而LADER则是单键的极限情况。
tldr: BRAG提出了一种贝叶斯检索生成模型，通过闭式滤波器在线更新每个记忆块的少量键和标量，将检索框架化为控制问题，并证明现有检索反馈方法均为该模型的特殊或极限情形。
en_tdlr: BRAG introduces a Bayesian generative model of retrieval that yields a closed-form online filter, frames retrieval as a control problem, and unifies existing feedback methods (query averaging, Rocchio, NUDGE, LADER) as special cases.
